title: The picture bench get writes mapping.json (exportPictureMapping of the final manifest on the run's kit) beside site-pictures.json and files/, and the write step's own reader accepts the folder
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-timeout=60000 apps/tracy-web/test/site-pictures-bench-mapping-export.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail and skipped counts.
expect: The run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.

The exported folder holds mapping.json, site-pictures.json and files/; mapping.json has exactly the keys hidden, mapping, painted, problems, siteSettings, uploads, and packageProblems and readPackageFiles of apps/tracy-web/src/write-step/picture-package.js accept it.
evidence: 05/11/2026: the brief to site chain could not be rerun on a new trial site because the picture bench wrote no mapping.json and the last run used a one-off export script that is gone.
fence: The export and the write step's file reader on a fabricated run. Not exercised: the Postgres-backed get command (site-pictures-bench-cli.test.mjs covers it when TEST_DATABASE_URL is set), a real site write.
